crossRefs.note: Which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of…

translations.web: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
translations.bsb: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
translations.kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
translations.asv: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
